macro_context.market_sentiment: Cautiously bullish — S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit new all-time highs on May 1 after a strong earnings season, but May 4 saw muted mixed action (S&P -0.18%, Nasdaq +0.04%) as traders monitored US-Iran conflict developments and rising oil prices. Sources: TheStreet, CNBC, Bloomberg.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% at the April 29 meeting (Powell's final as chair, stepping down May 15). FOMC split 8-4; median forecast is 1 cut in 2026. Elevated inflation partly attributed to Middle East energy disruption. Sources: CNBC, Al Jazeera, Yahoo Finance.
macro_context.geopolitical: US-Iran conflict ongoing in its third month; crude oil surged above $100/bbl with Strait of Hormuz traffic effectively halted. Equity markets recovered fully in April after an earlier 9% pullback, with energy sector top-performing YTD (+40%). Additional risks: tariff uncertainty, Fed leadership change, US midterm elections. Sources: Kitces, Enterprise Bank, Morgan Stanley.
key_events: Powell steps down as Fed Chair on May 15, 2026 — leadership transition uncertainty
US-Iran conflict ongoing; any escalation or peace deal could swing oil prices and risk appetite sharply
Q1 2026 earnings season largely complete; market now forward-looking to Q2 guidance
Next FOMC meeting date TBD — market pricing in 1 cut for full year 2026
US midterm elections on the horizon — political uncertainty for regulatory environment

ticker_news.headline: Meta Q1 2026 earnings: Revenue +33% YoY to $56.31B, beating estimates; stock fell 8.6% on $125-145B capex guidance raise
Meta to cut ~8,000 jobs (10% of workforce) starting May 20, with more layoffs planned for H2 2026 as AI restructuring accelerates
JPMorgan downgraded META to Neutral and cut price target to $725, citing intensifying full-stack AI competition and uncertain capex ROI
Meta debuts its first major AI model 'Muse Spark' from new Meta Superintelligence Labs, led by chief AI officer Alexandr Wang
Analysts debate whether Meta's AI capex surge ($125-145B) is a repeat of the costly Metaverse bet or a transformational AI moat

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: JPMorgan downgraded to Neutral with $725 target post-Q1 earnings (May 2026). Seeking Alpha noted a 'Shock and Awe' downgrade reaction. Despite this, 36-40 analysts covering META maintain a Strong Buy/Buy consensus with average price target ~$837 (range: $700-$1,015). Rothschild & Co upgraded from Neutral to Buy in January 2026. Sources: MarketBeat, StockAnalysis, Benzinga, Seeking Alpha.

web_context.competitor_activity: Alphabet (Google) and Amazon both reported Q1 2026 earnings with strong AI infrastructure spending — their stocks rose after hours, contrasting with Meta's post-earnings drop. OpenAI and Google remain the primary rivals for Meta's AI model ambitions; Meta's new 'Muse Spark' model is a direct attempt to close the gap. TikTok/ByteDance remains the top social media threat, driving continued Instagram Reels investment. Sources: CNBC, Fortune, Bloomberg.
web_context.earnings_info: Q1 2026 already reported on April 29, 2026. Revenue: $56.31B (+33% YoY). Capex guidance raised to $125-145B for full year 2026 (from $115-135B prior). Q2 2026 revenue guidance: $58-61B. Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected in late July 2026; exact date not yet announced. Sources: CNBC, investor.atmeta.com, MarketBeat.
